unlevered_return_capacity_analysis.economic_reasoning: While Track C data is fully available and causal backtesting is immediately possible, a strictly 1.0x unlevered market-neutral relative value portfolio (50% long / 50% short) captures only relative spread dispersion. Across crypto majors, median unlevered cross-sectional spread produces 20 to 40 bps/day gross before fees. Achieving >= 3.00% net daily return without leverage is mathematically inconsistent with empirical cross-sectional crypto volatility.

track_c_relative_value.falsifiable_hypothesis: H_C: Cross-sectional momentum, residual mean-reversion, and cointegrated pairs trading produce positive net expectancy and MDD <= 15% under strictly 1.0x unlevered exposure, though the mandatory >= 3.00% daily return gate represents an extreme structural hurdle.
